author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.17.1 — Diagnostic fix: the status poll handler used to silently return with zero logging if a response ever came back without vacuum_work_status, which -- if that's happening -- would explain status being frozen for hours (no transition ever detected, no notifications, sweep never continuing) while the separate props poll keeps working normally and looks fine. Now logs a warning with the raw response shape instead of failing silently, so the actual cause is visible instead of guessed at.
